{
  "correction_rules": [
    "Adjust forecasts downward when sentiment history shows negative bias (e.g., -0.25 or below) to counteract overconfidence.",
    "Reduce forecast magnitude by 5-10% if recent true outcomes show persistent underperformance relative to model highs.",
    "Apply mean reversion correction: if model peaks above 70.00+ and true outcome is below 65.00, reduce forecast by 10-15%.",
    "Increase forecast sensitivity to recent true outcomes when sentiment is neutral or positive (e.g., 0.00 or 0.50) to avoid lag.",
    "Cap forecast spikes above 75.00 unless sentiment is strongly bullish (e.g., >0.50) to prevent overshoot.",
    "When sentiment transitions from negative to neutral, gradually increase forecast alignment with recent true values over 3-5 days.",
    "If model consistently underpredicts in early days of a new sentiment cycle, apply a 3-5% upward bias to compensate for lag."
  ]
}
